variants.specifics: Brackenford: Brother Anselm's novice Pip and the Chapel's gravediggers went after the Urchins and are trapped in the barrow; lead them out to the barrow gate.

plea.speaker: Anselm
plea.text:
Good day. You would be the traveler who has been assisting the townsfolk, I believe.

My novice Pip went off after those Urchins with the Chapel's gravediggers, armed with nothing but shovels and a lantern. That was yesterday. Not one of them has returned, and I fear some abominable fate has befallen them.

Let us make an arrangement, you and I. Liberate the boy and those poor men and bring them home, and the Chapel will not forget your kindness.

reminder.speaker: Anselm
reminder.text: Have you found them? The Urchins came up out of the old barrow east of the ford. Try there!

found.speaker: Pip
found.text: Is someone there? It's Pip, from the Chapel! We're all in here! Please, get us back to the gate!

following.speaker: Pip
following.text: Keep together, everyone! Stay close behind!

completion.speaker: Anselm
completion.text:
Pip! You're alive! And the diggers with you!

Bless you, brave Adventurer! Please accept this ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Rescue Brother Anselm's novice Pip and the lost gravediggers.

variants.specifics: Bormunt: Hammel's daughter Nessa was dragged off by the Trolls to their pens east of the Great Shaft; she gives the key to the next cage, where Hask's wife is held.

plea.speaker: Hammel
plea.text:
Trolls! The Trolls have taken my daughter! They came up through the floor of the washing cave and dragged my Nessa away!

They keep a pen past the old ore chutes, on the east side of the Great Shaft. I'm no fighter, kind sir, I'd only get us both killed. Will you bring her home?

reminder.speaker: Hammel
reminder.text: What are you waiting for?! Please, find my girl!

found.speaker: Nessa
found.text:
Father sent you? Oh, thank goodness!

Here, take this key, I stole it off the Troll guard. It opens the cage next to mine. Hask's wife is in there!

following.speaker: Nessa
following.text: Please hurry! Father will be worried sick.

completion.speaker: Hammel
completion.text: Nessa! My girl! You're safe! Oh, thank you, kind sir, thank you! Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Rescue Hammel's daughter from the Troll pens.

variants.specifics: Oskry: Hadda, boss of the peat cutters; her cutters locked themselves in the old peat shed in the north bog when the dead came up, and she hands over the spare key.

plea.speaker: Hadda
plea.text:
Blast it! Blast it all! Of all the days! My peat cutters were out in the north bog this morning when the dead came up out of the water all around them!

They ran into the old peat shed and locked themselves in. It's north of the village, past the sunken barge. They won't open up for anybody, and I don't blame them.

Here's my offer. You take this spare key, open that shed and bring my cutters home. Do it and there's good gold in it for you!

reminder.speaker: Hadda
reminder.text: Go on! My cutters can't sit in that shed forever!

found.speaker: Peat cutter
found.text: The door! Thank goodness! We thought we'd die in here!

following.speaker: Peat cutter
following.text: Lead the way. We'll stay close.

completion.speaker: Hadda
completion.text: My cutters! Home, every one of them! Thank you, stranger! Here's 75 gold, as promised.

journal.text: Free Hadda's peat cutters from the shed in the north bog.

variants.specifics: Castle Brask: Ferrol the scribe begs the player to find his master Gondrel, a merchant taken on the road and found dying in the old toll house.

plea.speaker: Ferrol
plea.text: Kind sir! Help me, please! Master Gondrel's wagon came back without him! The horses were all lathered and the seat was... oh, there was blood on it! And I have his ledgers and nobody to sign them! I'm no fighter, I'd faint at the first sight of a Zombie. Will you find him?

reminder.speaker: Ferrol
reminder.text: Have you found him? Oh.... One of the soldiers said he saw lights in the old toll house on the marsh road. Maybe that's something?

found.speaker: Gondrel
found.text: Is... is someone there? Please... they left me for dead... Get me home.

following.speaker: Gondrel
following.text: Slower... please... I can't keep up.

completion.speaker: Ferrol
completion.text:
Master Gondrel! Oh, he's so pale! Someone fetch the healer, quick!

You've done all anyone could, kind sir. Take this pass, it has his seal on it. The guards at the north postern will let you come and go as you please.

journal.text: Find the merchant Gondrel and bring him back to Castle Brask.

variants.specifics: Vesk: Hesk, a gruff net maker; Imps carried off his crow Inky, cage and all, and Inky holds the key to the Imps' next cage.

plea.speaker: Hesk
plea.text:
Greetings, stranger.

My crow's gone. Inky. Imps came in the night and took him, cage and all.

Tell you what. You bring him back alive and I'll give you something I pulled out of the lake. Worth your while. Deal?

reminder.speaker: Hesk
reminder.text: No crow? Imps like holes in the ground. Try the old well behind the smokehouse.

found.speaker: Inky
found.text: Rawk! Over here! Get me out! Take the key, take the key! It opens the other cage! Rawk!

following.speaker: Inky
following.text: Rawk! Home! Take me home to Hesk!

completion.speaker: Hesk
completion.text:
Inky! You old fool, look at you. Thanks, stranger.

Here's what I promised. A robe. Fished it out of the lake last spring, all wet and weedy. Nobody ever came asking for it.

journal.text: Find Hesk's crow and bring him home.

variants.specifics: Vorne: Tibbald, a nervous apprentice, begs the player to find his master Quorn, who went to study the Imps and sits in a cage in the Lyceum cellars.

plea.speaker: Tibbald
plea.text: Greetings, Wanderer. Oh dear, oh dear... My master, Quorn, went off to study the Imps up close and he hasn't come home. He never misses his supper! Never! If you could find him and bring him back, you'd save my life. I'm sure he'd want you rewarded.

reminder.speaker: Tibbald
reminder.text: He was always talking about the cellars under the Lyceum. Have you looked down there?

found.speaker: Master Quorn
found.text: Hello? Over here, in the cage! Quick, let me out before those Imps come back to tickle me again!

following.speaker: Master Quorn
following.text: Careful! Those Imps put fire traps under the loose stones. I lost half my beard to one!

completion.speaker: Master Quorn
completion.text: Home! Supper! My own bed! I'm free!!! Tibbald, fetch this brave Adventurer the good potions off the top shelf. Thank you, thank you!

journal.text: Find Master Quorn and bring him safely home.

variants.specifics: Fort Kholm: Gelbrand the provisioner's sledge crew, robbed by the Trolls, are locked in the old salt store; he hands over the key.

plea.speaker: Gelbrand
plea.text:
Thieving, lumbering brutes! The Trolls fell upon my supply sledges and plundered every barrel!

My sledge crew escaped with their lives and barricaded themselves in behind a stout door. But now the abominable creatures have them besieged, and the cold will finish what the Trolls began. I fear for them.

I'll make you a bargain, stranger. Liberate my men and bring them home, and you will not find me ungrateful. Here is the key to their door. Go swiftly!

reminder.speaker: Gelbrand
reminder.text: My men are holed up in the old salt store under the north wall. Please, hurry!

found.speaker: Sledge crew
found.text: The key! You've got the key! Get us out of here, quick!

following.speaker: Sledge crew
following.text: Lead the way. We'll stay right behind you.

completion.speaker: Gelbrand
completion.text: My sledge crew, home safe! You have done a noble deed for Fort Kholm this day. Please, take this Ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Free Gelbrand's sledge crew from the Trolls.

variants.specifics: Fornath: Ambrus, a fussy old hermit, begs the player to free Tavik, one of Kasrak's scouts, from the Ogre stockade at the old quarry; he gives the cell key, and the reward is the way on into the Black Smeltery.

plea.speaker: Ambrus
plea.text:
Greetings, Wanderer. Careful where you step, those are my mushrooms. There. Much better.

One of Master Kasrak's scouts came past my hut a few nights back. Tavik, his name is. He was going up to spy on Gorvane's Ogres, and the brutes caught him. They've got him locked up in their stockade at the old quarry, northwest of here, past the broken bridge.

Last night one of those Ogres fell asleep against my door, and I took this key right off his belt. Here, it should open Tavik's cell. If you could bring the boy home, you'd ease an old man's worries, and Kasrak would owe you a great deal.

reminder.speaker: Ambrus
reminder.text: Go now, Wanderer! Tavik won't last long up there.

found.speaker: Tavik
found.text: Over here! Is that a key? Open it, quick!

following.speaker: Tavik
following.text: Lead on. I'm right behind you.

completion.speaker: Ambrus
completion.text:
Tavik! Home at last, and all in one piece! Thank you, brave Adventurer.

He tells me there's a back way into the Black Smeltery, through the old ore chute. Go and tell Master Kasrak at once!

journal.text: Free Tavik the scout from the Ogre stockade.

variants.specifics: Wendle Cross: Gorsk's quarrymen hid in the tunnels under the old quarry when the Skeletons came up; he gives the key to the west gate for them.

plea.speaker: Gorsk
plea.text: Yaaahh! Stay back! I've got a shovel and I'll use it!... Oh. You're no Skeleton. Thank goodness! The Skeletons came up out of the old quarry north of the Crooked Kettle and my lads ran down into the tunnels to hide. They're still down there! I'll tell you what, bring my men out safe and you can have my key to the west gate. It's the quickest way onto the Grey Moor.

reminder.speaker: Gorsk
reminder.text: My poor lads! Are they still down there? Hurry!

found.speaker: Quarryman
found.text: Someone's come for us! Up, lads, up! We're going home!

following.speaker: Quarryman
following.text: Not the left tunnel! That's where the Skeletons came from. Take the right one, past the old cart.

completion.speaker: Gorsk
completion.text: My lads! You brought them all back! Here's the key to the west gate, as I promised. Now go and see Telmarq at his tower. He's been asking after you.

journal.text: Rescue the quarrymen trapped in the tunnels under the old quarry.

variants.specifics: Hestle: Sister Alwen's novices were carried off to the Ogre camp across the river; the novice Ebbin, found first, gives the key to the other's pen.

plea.speaker: Sister Alwen
plea.text: Oh, it's dreadful! The Ogres have carried off my novices! They're locked in the pens at the Ogre camp across the river. Go and bring them home!

reminder.speaker: Sister Alwen
reminder.text: Please, hurry! The Ogres will eat them!

found.speaker: Ebbin
found.text: Who's there?... Oh, thank goodness! One of the Ogres dropped this key. It opens the other pen. Take it, quick!

following.speaker: Ebbin
following.text: Lead on! I'm right behind you!

completion.speaker: Sister Alwen
completion.text:
My novices! Home safe! Bless you, kind sir, bless you! Take this as a token of my appreciation.

Mayor Dulvane has been asking after you. Go and see him at the Town Hall.

journal.text: Rescue Sister Alwen's novices from the Ogre camp.
